text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motiooon!!
Great joook!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(It was fun as always,
and everyone was happy, so—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...What's the matter, I wonder,
Fine Motion?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's wrong?
That was a super great run!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but like...
Isn't it kinda different from the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?
Like that 'this is crazy fun~~' vibe just isn't there."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel like that wasn't like them.
Maybe it's just my imagination, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, Fine-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Um, are you... feeling alright today?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's nothing there, right...?
I was just a little curious, is all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like Fine-san's smile
is somehow a bit stiff..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm sorry for prying so much!
I'm sure it's just my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, you caught me?
I'm just feeling a tiny bit under the weather
compared to usual, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I knew it...!
You mustn't push yourself.
Please get plenty of rest today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because next time, I want to run
alongside a Fine-san who's in top form!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's smile after finishing the race... was stiff.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That's no good.
I was supposed to be fine..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Would you care to go for a stroll after this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~... What a pretty sunset♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The sunsets in Ireland were so beautiful too...
I used to watch them all the time from the castle."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, there's something I've always thought about.
'Why does the sunset have to go down?'
'If night never came, we could play so much more.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—'I'm so lonely'... That's what I thought.
Even though I've never said it to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur is right.
I haven't come to terms with it at all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I realized that
I just didn't want it to end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"This fun, happy time...
will be coming to an end soon."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Once I return to my homeland, these days will become distant, and one day everyone will forget.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That dreamlike time faded away, just like a real dream...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It'll be as if it never existed at all.
Nothing will be left behind...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That feels like such a lonely thing.
So, so heartbreaking... Maybe that's why.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I ended up wishing it would never end.
Even after crossing the finish line,
I wanted the race to keep going forever and ever—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —As if something like that could never end...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pheeew~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that clears things up!
I see, so that's what Shakur meant!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you run while wishing for it not to end,
your legs will naturally grow heavy. You won't be able to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really needed
to say it out loud, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Coming to terms with my own feelings...
—to become a cornerstone of my homeland."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah...!
That feels so refreshing♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Unlike before, that smile was one that showed she had truly moved on."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't talked
about the next race, have we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you have a plan,
would you care to share it with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a rotation in mind.
Right now, she commands immense popularity,
so the fans will likely want to see—
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the Takarazuka Kinen?
Why don't we aim for the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, isn't that a Grand Prix race?
The one where the fans vote for you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd love to run if possible.
I have to show everyone a smile straight from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With our next goal decided,
I was about to ask how she truly felt, but—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, my apologies.
Everyone is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, let's start the meeting.
—For after my return to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you head back first?
Let's ride the Shinkansen together on the way back♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Do I have time to touch up my makeup?
Also, please send the materials to my phone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she has spent all this time
conforming her heart to how it "ought to be,"
getting used to that mold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But is it really okay to just let her brush off "loneliness" as mere loneliness?
Does that truly count as confronting it—
